Retouched vanilla style portraits and sprites to match. Includes hair fixes, clothing adjustments, and recoloring. 

I wanted to improve on the designs of several characters that I felt could use more love. In some cases I was inspired by older pre-release art for the characters, but in others I completely reimagined their designs based on their personalities. 

Currently includes the bachelors and bachelorettes as well as a few side NPCs I felt needed an update. An optional version with a more forward-facing Elliott is available too. I may continue to include the rest of the NPCs in the future. 


[b][u][left]Version history:[/left][/u][/b][/size]Version 2.1: Added Linus and Pam portraits and sprites. Updated/fixed Elliott and Penny sprites

Version 2.0:  Added portraits and sprite reworks for Clint as well as characters' beach scenes
[size=2]
[/size]Version 1.2.0: Now compatible with/reliant on Content Patcher
